rules.patch_base: Always use this exact live baseline, or a newer baseline referenced by this file.
rules.github_actions_artifacts: Never treat a GitHub Actions artifact as the live production baseline unless CURRENT_RELEASE.json explicitly points to it.
rules.small_changes: Prefer a minimal patch containing only changed production files.
rules.promotion: Only advance CURRENT_RELEASE after the new build has actually been deployed and verified live.
rules.versioning: Do not invent or infer semantic version numbers. Use only identifiers explicitly supplied by the user or recorded from the deployed build.
